basic_details.job_title: MCD Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 15 Senior Resident Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (Anesthesia), Senior Resident (Pediatrics), Senior Resident (Obst. & Gynae) and 5 more
basic_details.short_information: Kasturba Hospital, Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), New Delhi, has invited applications for 15 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. CMO(Admin.)/KH/2026/844. The posts include Senior Resident (Anesthesia), Senior Resident (Pediatrics), Senior Resident (Obst. & Gynae), Senior Resident (Radiology) and 4 more. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 2 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed Application Performa - I & II from www.mcdonline.nic.in.
Fill all columns; self-attest all documents, number them top to bottom and arrange them as per the serial numbers in the form.
Arrange a Bank Draft/Pay Order in favour of COMMISSIONER, MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF DELHI, payable at Delhi.
Submit the application form with all required documents on 02.12.2026 between 09:00 A.M. and 11:00 A.M. in the office of Medical Superintendent, Daryaganj, New Delhi-110002.
Bring photocopies and originals of all required documents at the time of interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA paid for appearing for interview Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates of qualification, caste, age, DMC registration and internship completion Appointment authority may assign any duty; no extra allowance for such assignment Doctors found guilty of gross misconduct or negligence will be terminated without notice or payment in lieu of notice

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement for one year or till regular Specialist Doctors join Kasturba Hospital, whichever is earlier Total senior residency tenure will not normally exceed three years including other Govt. Hospitals Service can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason Inter hospital/inter institutional transfer not permitted Engagement gives no claim or right to regular appointment Service governed under Residency Scheme of Ministry of Health and Family Welfare dated 05/06/1992 and amendments

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 2 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: 2 Senior Resident (Anesthesia), 2 Senior Resident (Pediatrics), 4 Senior Resident (Obst. & Gynae), 2 Senior Resident (Radiology), 1 Senior Resident (Dermatology), 1 Senior Resident (Surgery) and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Auditorium of Kasturba Hospital, 2nd Floor, Library Hall, Daryaganj, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC: Rs. 1000. SC/ST: Rs. 500. Persons with Disability: Exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is UR & EWS - Not exceeding 45 years; SC, ST - Not exceeding 50 years; OBC - Not exceeding 48 years (as on last day of submission of application). Relaxation: UR & EWS Not exceeding 45 years, OBC Not exceeding 48 years, SC, ST Not exceeding 50 years, PwD 10 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix level-11 + Usual Allowances as admissible. for Senior Resident (Anesthesia), Pay Matrix level-11 + Usual Allowances as admissible. for Senior Resident (Pediatrics), Pay Matrix level-11 + Usual Allowances as admissible. for Senior Resident (Obst. & Gynae), Pay Matrix level-11 + Usual Allowances as admissible. for Senior Resident (Radiology), Pay Matrix level-11 + Usual Allowances as admissible. for Senior Resident (Dermatology).

faq.question: Q8. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS Degree from MCI / NMC recognized University/Institution and PG Degree/DNB/Diploma in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institute, registered with Delhi Medical Council; valid DMC registration of MBBS and PG Degree/Diploma. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q9. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid DMC Registration Certificate of MBBS along with registration of PG Degree/Diploma with DMC. OBC certificate must be issued by competent authority of GNCT of Delhi. Candidates in service must bring a No Objection Certificate from Head of Institution/employer, otherwise not allowed to appear. EWS candidates should submit the family income certificate (Annexure B) before the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed 3 years of senior residency are considered only from a separate list after fresh candidates are exhausted.
